item.tib: rdzogs chen gser thur mkha' 'gro las rgya brtags pa'i dwangs gsal me long rgya mtsho
item.coloph: bdag 'dra bI ros yi ger bris/ gsal stong nyams len cha rkyen du/ rdo rje chu 'thung gdams pa bstan/ las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya rdo rje chu 'thungs 'khron chung rkyang 'dren bya ba rdzogs so// mdo sngags kun gyi bdag po/ theg pa chen pos (po'i) rnal 'byor pa bon zhig gling pa'i (pas) gdams pa'o//
